You recognize the opening in your opponent’s recovery and drive a precise strike into it before they regain their balance.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Agility
Target / range / shape
One adjacent creature.
Duration
Instant. Applied conditions follow their normal duration and decay.
Equipment / acquisition
Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Step inside the familiar pattern and finish your melee attack before they find a new one.

Weak
5 physical damage.
Standard
5 physical damage and Dazed 1.
Strong
7 physical damage and Dazed 2.
